# Omen Windows

by VisionGLLast Updated: March 25, 2026

### Advertisement

This website is supported by ads.

Omen Windows are random encounters, similar to Nemesis and Rift Beasts. They are a horde-based mechanic, where you engage swarms of smaller Fractured Enemies before challenging a stronger Omen enemy. Defeating the Omen at the end of an Omen Window drops exclusive loot types such as Timeglass Fragments, Rune of Corruption, Corrupted Items, Omen Idols, and Idol Altars.

## Interacting with Omen Windows

Omen Windows
Walk into the ring surrounding an Omen Window to begin the encounter. At the beginning of an Omen Window encounter, the Omen enemy is invulnerable. Slaying the smaller Fractured Enemies fills a progress bar and advances the Omen Window.

Omen Window Progress Bar

When the progress bar is full, Phase 2 begins. The Omen absorbs the remaining Fractured enemies, empowers itself, and becomes vulnerable. There are four different types of Omens that you might face here, each with different attacks, patterns, appearances, and voicelines.

Leaving the Omen Window's ring begins a 10-second countdown. If you don't return to the ring before the timer expires, the encounter fails. Re-entering the ring causes the timer to slowly increase back up to 10 seconds.

Omen Window

### Omen Window Difficulties

Omen Windows have five Difficulty Tiers. The Difficulty Tier affects the number of Magic, Rare, and Champion enemies that spawn within your Omen Window encounters. Higher tiers of Omen Windows drop more Timeglass Fragments and loot, as well as having increased chances to drop rare Idol Altars.

Tier 3 Greater Omen Window

## Greater Omen Windows

Omen Windows
Greater Omen Windows only spawn at the end of Omen Window Echo Chains or Pinnacle of Chaos Echo Chains. Three Omen Windows are also found in the Omen's Veil Woven Echo. This special type of Omen Window has more challenging enemies in the first phase, and two Omens to defeat in Phase 2.

Completing a Greater Omen Window causes a Timeglass Core to form. Interacting with the core gives you a choice to spend Timeglass Fragments to spawn an Echo Chain of your choice, or to shatter the core and gain additional Timeglass Fragments.

The Timeglass Core

## The Benefits of Omen Windows

Omen Windows
Defeating the Omen within an Omen Window drops loot, including Timeglass Fragment, Rune of Corruption, Corrupted Items, Omen Idols, and Idol Altars. These items are tied specifically to Omens and are not dropped by regular enemies.

### Timeglass Fragments

Timeglass Fragment is a new currency that drops from Omens or is gained from shattering the Timeglass Core at the end of a Greater Omen Window.

This currency is traded with Apophis the Oracle at the center of the Monolith of Fate, in exchange for Runes of Corruption, Corrupted Item Crates, the Omen's Veil Woven Echo, and more.

Trading Timeglass Fragments

## Finding Omen Windows

Omen Windows
Omen Windows become available as early as Chapter 2. You continue to encounter them throughout the Campaign and Monolith of Fate Echoes.

Omen Window Echo Chains also have a chance to spawn naturally within your Echo Webs as you begin progressing through the End Game, and are a great option for encountering back-to-back Omen Windows. Completing a Greater Omen Window at the end of the Echo Chain and interacting with the Timeglass Core gives the option to force an Omen Window Echo Chain (or the more difficult Pinnacle of Chaos Echo Chain) into your Echo Web, ensuring more Omen Windows to interact with.

The Pinacle of Chaos Echo Chain option contains Omen Window encounters, with one key difference. Pinnacle of Chaos Echo Chains end with a Greater Omen Window filled with Champions instead of regular enemies. This makes it a much more difficult option.

Pinnacle of Chaos Echo Chain

## Summary

Omen Windows
- Omen Windows are a horde-based encounter that includes fighting off a swarm of enemies before facing a more powerful Omen enemy.
- Defeating Omens rewards Timeglass Fragment, Rune of Corruption, Corrupted Items, Omen Idols, and Idol Altars
- Greater Omen Windows are found at the end of Omen Window Echo Chains, Pinnacle of Chaos Echo Chains, and in the Omen's Veil Woven Echo. This variation contains two Omens to defeat.
- Completing Greater Omen Windows at the end of Echo Chains gives the option to force more Echo Chains into your Echo Web in exchange for Timeglass Fragments.
